Name: Tanned Abigail - Cat Maid - Seasonal - sprite and portrait with optional Nyapu style portraits
Author: LurchingElf
Description:
This is a sprite and portrait replacement mod for Abigail.
Tested and compatible with SDV v1.6.14 and v1.5.6. (possibly even older versions too, since the script in the content file is kept simple)
Animated sprite previews, be sure to check it out! just click on it and view in the popup menu! :3

if you don't want to request features here for some reason or you just want to some sneakpeeks of the creation process of further projects or want to hang out and chat with me (the creator) then join my [url=https://discord.gg/Ejdek26d7c]Discord server[/url]﻿, feel free to chat me up suggest things or just lurk around anything is fine my me!

if you came to like this mod then endorse it or throw me a cheer on Discord, i always appreciate seeing my work making others happy.
in case you think about supporting me, you can find me on [url=https://ko-fi.com/lurchingelf]Ko-fi[/url] too. check it out, there might be other things you like there.

version 1.0 still work flawlessly with Smapi 4.5.2 and CP 2.9.1 when installed manually.
Vortex syntaxing is entirely broken as of late, the mod will likely fail to load if installed through Vortex. most likely ModDrop will also be unreliable for installing this mod. so if you have issues related to this please try manual install first, if you wish to use this mod.
all you need to do is to manually download and unpack and paste into your mod folder [color=#999999]( you can decompress the zipfile with anything you like, 7zip, winRAR, window's built in compression utility, does not matter anything works, really! )[/color] 

Contains:
[list]
[*]a new reworked busty/curvy tanned Abigail in a barmaid outfit with black and lace pattern of 2 color, purple and pumpkin, available to be selected in both spring, summer and fall[/*]
[*]as well in a short coat with white tufted trimmings, in 3 color variants (blue llac and purple) for winter outfit[/*]
[*]also an appropriate bikini as beach outfit for ginger island excursions with 3 color choices matching the winter coat colors, and also bikinis available as full spritesheet variants for summer optionally.[/*]
[*]all mainland spritesheets contain fishing frames, that can be used in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4582]NPC Adventures[/url]﻿.[/*]
[/list][i]You can download NPC Adventures compatibility patch for SDV v1.5.6 as an optional file on my other mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3949]Tanned Abigail in bikini sprite and portrait[/url]﻿.[/i][i]but as mentioned there, the compatibility patch only contains the edited files (animation descriptions, buff descriptions, parameter, skill and dialogue edits), not the binaries, so you need to have NPC Adventures installed beforehand, which is only available for v1.5.6 so far since, because [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68185132]purrplingcat[/url]﻿ is yet to release the official v1.6 compatible version of NPC Adventures.
[/i]
[list]
[*]conventional 10 frame portrait sheets available in Vanilla alike and Nyapu alike styles, with matching outfits for every spritesheet.[/*]
[/list][i]But be advised if you are using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's current v1.6 ready vanilla portraits[/url]﻿, you actually have to remove the Abigail.png, Abigail_Winter.png and Abigail_Beach.png portrait files from the assets of that mod manually since that mod has no individual toggle-ability for each character so their mod will take priority over mine otherwise.

[/i]You can select colors and spritesheets options via Generic Mod Config Menu, or by manually editing the config file.

[list]
[*]and last but not least: [size=4]SHE IS A CAT![/size]
[size=3]contains blue cat ears and tail with white tip that follow her movement pattern and emotions in every sprite and portrait frame
(please ask for permission if you want to use my assets as guide/starting post for your own art. It took me friggin forever to draw those from scratch, i don't want it stolen just like that. [b]also, i forbid using my content being used as material in creating AI generated images.[/b])[/size][/*]
[/list]
This mod has full [b]seasonal[/b] integration in both SDV v1.6.14 and v1.5.6 natively. just turn off Abigail's overrides in Seasonal Cute Outfits GMCM options to avoid collision.
